status: unreleased audit follow-up; not a publication

findings.problem: M4A probe validated a tag against mdhd instead of the selected AAC packet count, both accepting stale tags and rejecting correct tags with stale/absent mdhd.
findings.resolution: Read a structurally bounded stsz count without allocating a sample index; share exact packet-grid validation with decoding.

findings.problem: A raw 180-byte scan could borrow iTunSMPB text from unrelated or sibling MP4 metadata and apply an unintended trim.
findings.resolution: Use the existing bounded box iterator and require moov/udta/meta/ilst/---- with matching mean/name and a UTF-8 data value; ignore duplicates and ambiguous items.

findings.problem: The separate gapless MP4 walker did not support 64-bit moov headers even though the demuxer supported them.
findings.resolution: Reuse the demuxer box reader rather than maintaining a second header parser.

findings.problem: ID3v2.3 frame sizes were interpreted as v2.4 syncsafe integers, dropping ordinary long COMM/TXXX values.
findings.resolution: Select big-endian or syncsafe frame lengths by version, use checked frame bounds, and limit footer handling to v2.4.

findings.problem: Presentation-sample M4aSeek playback ignored tag-only trim while one-shot and seekable streaming applied it.
findings.resolution: Apply the same validated window at open; report its priming/remainder and bounded completion. Keep persistent checkpoints excluded for tag-only sources.

findings.problem: Tag validation used hard-coded 1024/2048/512 packet sizes instead of actual ASC frame length and output/core rate ratio.
findings.resolution: Share ASC-derived packet geometry, including 960/480 cores and downsampled output.
findings.evidence: Confirmed by source inspection; 960-core decode/probe regression and parsed 480-core ASC arithmetic are tested after the change.

findings.problem: Text scanning could restart inside malformed fields; saturating arithmetic was duplicated across acceptance paths.
findings.resolution: Parse four exact-width fields at the value start with a reserved zero; centralize checked totals and packet multiplication. Invalid/overflowing candidates cannot arm push trimming.
findings.evidence: Source audit of the old resynchronising parser and saturating validation; direct format/arithmetic regressions protect the new policy.

refactoring: Separate the text codec and MP4 metadata reader.
Reuse the existing box iterator and keep metadata probing allocation-independent of declared frame counts.
Move metadata-only AAC selection and M4aSeek opening into focused modules.
Share independent standard MP4 fixtures across tests; keep fixtures out of the package.
Add a generated Apple-layout M4A seed to both isolated fuzz harnesses.
boundaries: Legacy incorrect syom field order is deliberately not guessed.
Only the documented Apple freeform UTF-8 item is read; arbitrary raw udta strings are not gapless metadata.
Push fragmented MP4 still does not consume iTunSMPB; bounded one-shot/seekable paths do.
Push ADTS still applies modest tags before final length confirmation by its existing streaming contract.
Probe validates declared metadata geometry, not payload authenticity or successful full decode.
No local afconvert or AudioToolbox execution. End-to-end 960-core fixture tested; 480-core change tested via parsed ASC geometry, not a new external decoder vector.
harness_cleanup: Four pre-existing isolated Clippy style lints were corrected without changing mutation distributions; Rust 1.89 and final fuzz rerun passed.
